subject: Sponsor outcomes, payoff expectations, risk commitments
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@novastream.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@novastream.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap from this morning — priorities and constraints

Thanks again for the call this AM. Wanted to put a short note capturing the parts my execs care about so we can align on next steps. High-level takeaways from our side: 

- Primary business outcome: reduce support triage time by ~40% and deflect 20% of inbound tickets in Q4.
- Key constraint: any pilot cannot send PII outside our VPC (approval requirement).
- Procurement path: SOW + one-month pilot, then fast-follow if results match the ROI slide.
- Budget guardrails: pilot budget approved up to $45k; anything above needs VP sign-off.

Open asks for Redwood:
1) Short SOW template (1 page) and an estimate breakdown (hardware + run costs)
2) SOC2 evidence pointers — which artifacts do you need from us, and what evidence can you provide?
3) A concise list of acceptance criteria for the pilot (performance + quality).

I'll loop legal/procurement early next week, but want to make sure we have the exec summary for their packet.

—Claire
Claire Jensen
Chief Product Officer, Novastream

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@novastream.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap from this morning — priorities and constraints

Claire — thank you for the clear priorities. Short version from our side and agreed next steps below.

Executive summary (for your packet):
- Outcome: Validate 40% triage reduction and 20% ticket deflection in a 30-day sandbox pilot. We will provide per-ticket latency and cost estimates and a before/after sample set.
- Risk & constraint handling: We support a private VPC deployment option (no egress of PII). For pilot: we can run inside your VPC with customer-operated keys.
- Procurement path: 30-day pilot via SOW, pilot cap at $45k. If acceptance criteria met, roll to 12-month committed capacity with negotiated SLA.

Deliverables we will share by EOD Wed (Jun 10):
- 1-page SOW draft + line-item cost (Novastream_Q3_pilot_ROI.xlsx attached)
- SOC2 artifacts checklist and what we can provide (see Requested_SOC2_evidence_list.pdf)
- Suggested acceptance criteria (accuracy, triage reduction, latency percentiles)

Open items for Novastream to confirm:
- Confirm which data subsets will be used in the pilot (redacted logs vs full records).
- Assigned legal/procurement contact for review of the SOW (name + email).
- Any non-functional constraints beyond PII (e.g., retention windows).

Next cadence: proposed internal kickoff Wed (Jun 17) if legal signs off by then — otherwise will push one week.

I'll let Marissa add rollout/ops detail and Ben add pricing nuance.

Best,
Irene Choi
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@novastream.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap from this morning — priorities and constraints

Claire — adding operations acceptance criteria and a brief pilot runbook for your packet. Key operational checks we will measure during pilot: 

- Latency: P95 token latency must be <= 220ms for triage flows (baseline capture pre-pilot).
- Throughput: handle 50 concurrent triage sessions with steady-state batching to control unit cost.
- Observability: access to per-route latency and token cost dashboards for your SREs (read-only).
- Rollback: automatic fallback to cached responses if model variant performance drops >8% on held set.

Proposed pilot timeline (compact):
- Week 0: SOW & security review
- Week 1: VPC onboarding + 48-hour smoke tests
- Weeks 2–3: Live sampling & metrics collection
- Week 4: Acceptance window and final readout

I'll attach the short runbook and include contacts for the VPC onboarding team; Ben will follow with a brief pricing sketch that stays within the $45k pilot cap and outlines commit tiers if you convert.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@novastream.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap from this morning — priorities and constraints

Claire — quick note on commercials to align with the packet you send to Procurement/Finance:

- Pilot cost: fixed $42,500 (includes dedicated reserved GPU window for the 30-day pilot, VPC onboarding support, and one integration support day).
- If pilot meets acceptance criteria, proposed conversion: 12-month reserved capacity at $5,800/mo with a 10% usage discount for the first renewal year.
- Exceptions: Any on-prem appliance or custom HSM integration will be scoped separately (cost TBD).

I attached the ROI workbook that maps estimated ticket deflection to monthly savings. Happy to carve a clean line item for "pilot cap" in the SOW to make approvals smoother.

If you can confirm procurement contact (Raj.patel@novastream.com copied on Claire's original note) we'll send the SOW and the SOC2 checklist to legal this afternoon.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference
